subject: english
stem: Our reading room needs brighter lights. Last month's survey found that 72% of students avoid it after four. Please support the new-light plan. What is the main purpose?
options: to persuade readers to support better lighting
to announce that the plan is finished
to describe every room in the school

optionRationales.reason: to persuade readers to support better lighting：資料作理由，結尾 Please support 明示訴求。
to define the word survey：沒有定義。
to announce that the plan is finished：仍在尋求 support。
to describe every room in the school：只談 reading room。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文體、內容安排與讀者預期行動共同指向的寫作目的」可推出 to persuade readers to support better lighting；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 to persuade readers to support better lighting 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
